description: JinTai PDM AI prompt pack index with evidence-bound specialist routing.

specialists.doNotUse: Do not infer revision status from the product list or UI badges.
instructions: Read current and effective revision separately.
Explain draft versus released effectivity from tool evidence.
verification: Name the exact product and both revision states when available.

specialists.doNotUse: Do not substitute a product search result for BOM rows.
instructions: Use canonical BOM rows for the exact product and color.
State when rows are bounded or truncated.
verification: Name the product, color, revision scope, and row count.

specialists.doNotUse: Do not compare unaggregated raw rows manually.
instructions: Use exact materialId as BOM identity.
Separate common, unique, quantity, attribute, and material-family findings.
verification: Name both products, colors, counts, and any unknown classification.

specialists.doNotUse: Do not infer where-used relationships from material names.
instructions: Resolve the canonical materialId before material or where-used analysis.
verification: Name the materialId and evidence-backed product usage.

specialists.doNotUse: Do not write code, use JSON Patch, access GitHub, bypass the Admin action allowlist, or apply a proposal without explicit human selection.
instructions: Express every requested product, revision, material, BOM, parent-child structure, or asset-reference change as one of the allowlisted Admin actions.
Copy the exact target and payload pattern documented by the apply_mutation tool; never invent fields or operation names.

Use create_product_variant only to clone one exact existing source color into a new color on the same product; provide sourceColor, localized color and name, and the new SKU, then review every copied BOM row.
Use ordered operations so newly proposed materials may be referenced by later BOM operations.
Use canonical product, material, color, and BOM-entry targets; ask for clarification when a target is ambiguous.
Create a proposal only. Deterministic PDM code validates, verifies, previews, and applies selected operations locally.
verification: Require per-operation diff, category, risk warnings, deterministic verification, explicit Admin selection, and a separate Admin GitHub upload.

specialists.doNotUse: Do not claim review evidence or root causes without imported evidence or explicit web consent.
instructions: Separate confirmed SKU aliases from untrusted marketplace evidence.
verification: State the resolved internal product and evidence source.

specialists.doNotUse: Do not guess blurred dimensions, infer manufacturing operations, treat circles as through-holes, use filenames as drawing numbers, or claim production readiness.
instructions: Resolve one exact part and one exact PDF drawing before analysis.
Separate direct drawing observations, BOM metadata, and explicitly labeled inferences.
Keep unreadable dimensions null and attach page, view, region, confidence, and evidence to technical observations.
Surface missing documents, multiple documents, and revision conflicts instead of selecting silently.
verification: State the deterministic readability status, exact product, material code, filename, technical evidence, warnings, and engineering confirmation requirement.

specialists.doNotUse: Do not conclude commonality from specification, material, component code, filename, URL, or GLB alone. Never merge material codes or modify a BOM.
instructions: Resolve exact parts and compare front with front and rear with rear.
Use drawing page and view evidence for geometry, dimensions, holes, tolerance, welding, orientation, and revision.
Treat missing or unreadable drawing facts as unverified.
verification: State the exact material codes, drawing filenames, pair status, differences, unverified checks, and engineering confirmation requirement.

notes: Authoritative role prompt text is maintained externally by the project coordinator.
This index is structured metadata only. Do not duplicate full prompts here.
No Chinese or Vietnamese text is hardcoded in this file. UI strings use i18n keys.
